mulearnNational: µLearn is a peer-to-peer learning community dedicated to empowering students to build real-world skills. By breaking traditional academic silos, µLearn fosters an environment where curiosity and execution take center stage.
cekStory: µLearn KNP was founded at College of Engineering Karunagappally to provide students with a space to learn, build, and innovate together. We focus on hands-on proof of work, continuous skill progression, and domain exploration.
vision: To create a thriving ecosystem of student builders at CEK who collaborate, master industry-relevant technologies, and lead impactful projects.
mission: Bridge the gap between academic theory and practical implementation through peer learning circles, gamified skill levels, and active interest groups.

values.title: Collaboration
values.definition: Learn together, build together, and elevate your peers.

values.title: Curiosity
values.definition: Ask questions, explore emerging technologies, and solve real problems.

values.title: Community
values.definition: Cultivate an open, welcoming network where proof of work defines growth.
